thread:
Tina (Eng PM): Hey team — postmortem draft is up: https://go/redwood/postmortem/1918. Need quick decisions on external briefing: status page wording, customer summary content, and policy for sharing the full root-cause doc with customers who request it. /cc @Emily (Customer Ops)

Raj (SRE): Reading now. TL;DR: outage caused by cache eviction race + fallback that overwhelmed DB replicas. We have a mitigation but want to mark what we tell customers.

Emily (Customer Ops): Thanks. We need a short statuspage blurb + a slightly longer customer-facing summary (one page) that we can paste into support replies. Also need to decide whether we allow full root-cause PDFs on request or only per-contract.

Jason (Product): For statuspage, keep it technical but non-blaming. Customers want clarity + ETA for fixes. Suggest: "We experienced degraded API availability caused by a backend cache eviction bug; mitigation in place; full postmortem forthcoming."

Marta (Legal): We should avoid admitting systemic negligence. Also check contract clauses before sharing full internal docs. If a customer requests the full doc, we can provide a redacted version and escalate to Legal for review.

Raj (SRE): Suggest two artifacts: (1) statuspage short summary, (2) customer summary (non-sensitive technical details), (3) internal root-cause with timeline and logs (internal only).

Emily (Customer Ops): Proposed timelines: statuspage update within 2 hours of this thread, customer summary draft within 48 hours, and a process for customer requests for full doc — escalate to Legal + Solutions.

Tina (Eng PM): Agree. Let's make owners and deadlines concrete.

Tina (Eng PM): ACTION-1: Emily to publish statuspage text and notify Support by EOD today (1918030000).

Emily (Customer Ops): Ack — will draft and post. Putting a short draft here for quick review: ```Status update: We experienced an intermittent API degradation between 10:12–10:37 UTC caused by a backend cache eviction bug that led to increased database load. We implemented a mitigation and traffic has returned to normal. We are performing a full postmortem and will share findings."```

Raj (SRE): Minor tweak: replace "intermittent" with "brief" and add "no customer data was exposed" if confirmed.

Tina (Eng PM): Good catch. Confirmed: no customer data exposure. Emily, include that sentence.

Emily (Customer Ops): Updated draft: ```Status update: We experienced a brief API degradation between 10:12–10:37 UTC caused by a backend cache eviction bug that increased database load. We implemented mitigations and traffic has returned to normal. No customer data was exposed. A full postmortem will be published in the coming days with actionable steps we are taking to prevent recurrence.```

Jason (Product): LGTM. Add a line pointing to incident SLAs for enterprise customers? Might help reduce support noise.

Marta (Legal): Fine with the language. For sharing the internal root-cause, here's the recommended policy: provide a redacted timeline and remediation plan to customers on a per-request basis after Legal review. No raw logs or sensitive internal IDs.

Emily (Customer Ops): ACTION-2: I'll create a request flow doc for Support -> Solutions -> Legal with a template redaction checklist. Target: 72 hours (1918110000).

Raj (SRE): ACTION-3: I'll prepare the internal root-cause doc with timeline, mitigations, and follow-ups. Will mark sensitive sections for redaction. Draft ETA: 48 hrs (1918060000).

Tina (Eng PM): ACTION-4: I'll create follow-up tickets for recurring pattern tracking: (a) add longer-term KV cache invariants tests, (b) add alerting on cache eviction rates, (c) run a 6-week regression check. Owners: Raj for (a)/(b), QA for (c). Due: 2 weeks (1919144567).

IncidentBot: New incident action items created: INC-A1 (Emily) INC-A2 (Raj) INC-A3 (Tina). See https://go/redwood/incidents/1918/actions

Emily (Customer Ops): Quick question: for customers who ask for the full postmortem, do we offer a call? Could be helpful for big partners.

Marta (Legal): We can offer a call with Solutions + SRE for enterprise partners after we've redacted and agreed on content. Keep calls documented and avoid sharing raw logs.

Jason (Product): Also flagging recurring incident pattern: this is our third cache-related degradation in 9 months. We should consider a small rewrite or library bump instead of ad-hoc fixes. Add a long-lived project to roadmap.

Tina (Eng PM): Noted. ACTION-5: Jason to propose roadmap slot + cost estimate for root-cause project. Due: 2 weeks (1919144567).

Raj (SRE): One more operational note — add a canary that simulates eviction storm at low traffic. I'll add as an alert playbook item.

Emily (Customer Ops): I'll post the statuspage update in ~30m and send a canned reply for Support tickets. Will ping this thread when done.

Tina (Eng PM): Thanks everyone. If there are no objections, we'll publish the customer summary after Raj's internal draft and Marta's ok on redactions. Final decision: public statuspage update now, customer summary in 48h, internal root-cause (internal only) in 48h, redacted doc to be available on request after Legal review.

Raj (SRE): No objections.

Marta (Legal): No objections.

Emily (Customer Ops): Posted statuspage and sent canned reply. Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1918 — pinged Support. (1918007890)

Tina (Eng PM): Closing thread for decisions. We'll track the action items in the postmortem and in the incident board. If anything changes, please update the action links. :white_check_mark:
